product_brief: Digital signature and PKI server with production-grade Post-Quantum Cryptography support for certificates, CRLs, and CMS signatures.
pqc_capability_description: Production-grade PQC support introduced in v8.3.5 (July 2024). Supports NIST-standardized ML-DSA (CRYSTALS-Dilithium) and ML-KEM (CRYSTALS-Kyber). Covers X.509 certificates, CRLs, OCSP responses, CMS signatures, and timestamp tokens. Compliant with RFC 9881 and RFC 9882.
key_management_model: HSM-backed (mentioned in context of "HSM-backed PQC deployments" and "Server-side PKCS#1 signatures" on SAM Appliance)
pqc_roadmap_details: Supports finalized NIST standards (FIPS 203, 204, 205). FALCON algorithm slated for upcoming standardization.
testing_&_validation_methods: Provides downloadable artefacts for independent validation of ASN.1 encoding alignment with RFC 9881 and RFC 9882.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Supports hybrid classical and post-quantum deployment models; allows transition without disrupting established trust models.

product_brief: Post-quantum security add-on that cross-signs digitally signed documents with NIST-recommended PQC algorithms and timestamps them on a blockchain.
pqc_capability_description: SignQuantum is a self-hosted add-on that automatically cross-signs documents using NIST’s primary-recommended FIPS 204 standard ML-DSA (based on CRYSTALS-DILITHIUM). It integrates with existing e-signature software to add a secondary post-quantum signature and records document hashes on the QAN Enterprise Blockchain for immutable timestamps.
key_management_model: Self-hosted; users maintain complete control of cryptographic keys on their own infrastructure.
supported_blockchains: QAN Enterprise Blockchain (self-hosted); public blockchains (optional for document hashes)
architecture_type: Self-hosted application add-on with blockchain integration
fips_validated: Uses NIST’s primary-recommended FIPS 204 standard ML-DSA
primary_platforms: Bare metal, Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker Swarm, Virtual Machines (VMs)
target_industries: Banking, Insurance, Pharma, IT, Manufacturing, Government, Supply Chain
regulatory_status: Configurable to meet GDPR, industry standards, and regional regulations
pqc_roadmap_details: Currently implements NIST’s recommended FIPS 204 ML-DSA (CRYSTALS-DILITHIUM) for cross-signing.
signature_schemes: ML-DSA (CRYSTALS-DILITHIUM); "today's standard algorithms" (specific legacy algorithms not named)
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Integrates seamlessly with top e-signature software (DocuSign, Signaturit, Dropbox Sign, PandaDoc, Adobe Sign) without requiring modifications to current processes or workflows.

product_brief: A post-quantum digital signature scheme introduced by Kryptonite as a replacement for GOST 34.10-2018.
pqc_capability_description: Shipovnik is a post-quantum digital signature scheme designed by Kryptonite researchers. It is described as Russia’s first post-quantum signature scheme, intended to replace the classic GOST 34.10-2018 elliptic-curve signature. It has been made open-source to encourage analysis and is being considered by the TC26 working group for standardization.
license: Open Source (specific license identifier not stated)
target_industries: Government, Critical Infrastructure (implied by Russian standardization context)
regulatory_status: Under evaluation by Rosstandart Technical Committee 26 (TC26) for potential GOST standardization.
pqc_roadmap_details: Being considered by the TC26 working group for approval as a GOST standard in the near future (expected within the next couple of years from late 2025).
testing_&_validation_methods: Made open-source to encourage analysis; subject to cryptanalysis by the National Technology Center for Digital Cryptography.
